root_text: @MdBreathe My son just had HIB and streptococcus pneumonia as OIs with his HMPV. Wasn’t a big deal.  Cost benefit analysis on all vaccines as we looked at each one by one wasn’t worth it. Also was eligible for RSV monoclonal and he got RSV.
